decisions.reason: The cited DAHA Definition explicitly imposes ZZ^{-1}=Z^{-1}Z=1 in relation 1, and the Given fixes that generator-and-relation algebra. Thus adjacent lattice letters multiply to Z to the sum of their integer exponents. F1 is a summary, not a replacement for the defined algebra. The Bernstein corrections are finite Laurent sums; the lexicographic reduction lowers Hecke count on correction terms and lattice/reflection inversions on main terms, after which the quadratic and pi relations give the claimed alternating spanning words. No independence or choice is used.

Step 3.1 inferred equality of coefficients of powers of Y from equality in the represented Y algebra without proving that those powers are independent. Generation by an invertible element only supplies a quotient of a Laurent algebra, so this is an unsupported inference in the given proof. Replaced it by p(Y)=(p(Y)+p(Y^{-1}))/2 and paired the averaged coefficients; this uses exactly the stated invariance and characteristic zero, and is valid even without injective evaluation. The recurrence for Y^n+Y^{-n}, together with the checked restriction Y+Y^{-1}=D and preservation of V, completes the unchanged claim.
